name: publaynet_bench
description: PublayNet is a document layout analysis benchmark that measures models' ability to detect and segment structural elements (e.g., title, text, figure, table) in document images. It is used to evaluate object-detection and segmentation performance for document understanding and OCR-preprocessing systems. The benchmark emphasizes layout-aware extraction accuracy across a wide variety of scientific and technical documents.
reputation: Widely used benchmark in the document layout and OCR community for training and evaluating layout-detection models.
